description: This Java source file defines the WebSiteWorker class, which provides utility methods related to website information retrieval, such as obtaining the website ID from a request, and fetching website data from the database.

classes.name: WebSiteWorker
classes.description: Utility class for website-related functionalities within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getWebSiteId
methods.description: Retrieves the website ID from the servlet context associated with the request.

methods.name: getWebSite
methods.description: Fetches the website's GenericValue object based on the request context.

methods.name: findWebSite
methods.description: Queries the database to find a website entity matching the provided website ID, with optional caching.
